mapper.select: select * from (select 0 as times,lcw.due_date as planned_due_date, -(lcw.due_amount) as planned_due_amount,NULL AS profit,lcw.due_amount current_net_amount from lon_contract_withdraw lcw where lcw.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} union all select lcr.times , lcr.planned_due_date,(select nvl(sum(lcr1.planned_due_amount),0) from lon_contract_repayment lcr1 where lcr1.planned_due_date = lcr.planned_due_date and lcr1.AMORTIZATION_METHOD != 'ONCE' AND lcr1.cf_item in (301,302) and lcr1.withdraw_id = lcr.withdraw_id),case when (SELECT count(0) FROM lon_contract_repayment lcr1 WHERE AMORTIZATION_METHOD = 'BALANCE' AND lcr1.withdraw_id = lcr.withdraw_id AND cf_item IN ( 303, 304 ) ) = 0 then lcr.planned_due_amount else null end AS profit, (select nvl(sum(lcr2.due_amount),0) from lon_contract_repayment lcr2 where lcr2.withdraw_id=lcr.withdraw_id and lcr2.cf_item=301 and lcr2.due_date>lcr.due_date) current_net_amount from lon_contract_repayment lcr where lcr.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} and cf_item = 302 ) t order by t.planned_due_date
select amortization_method from lon_contract_repayment where withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} and cf_item = #{cfItem} and rownum=1

SELECT min( gcc.times ) FROM gld_lon_repayment_merge gcc WHERE gcc.planned_due_date > ( SELECT max( fi.end_date ) FROM gld_lon_contract_fin_cost fi WHERE fi.post_flag = 'Y' AND fi.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId} )
AND gcc.withdraw_id = #{withdrawId}
